playstyle.identity: Tahm Kench is a protective tank who eats allies to save them or enemies to kill them. His W is a long-range engage tool.
playstyle.howToPlay: Q is a skillshot that slows and stuns if target has 3 stacks. W travels underground and knocks up enemies on arrival. E stores damage taken to shield or heal. R devours ally (protective) or enemy with 3 stacks (offensive). Use W for engage, R to save carries.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Tahm Kench spikes at levels 3-6 with trading and R. Tank items scale his shield. He's strong at protecting allies and trading.

strengths: Can eat allies to save them

passive.name: An Acquired Taste
passive.summary: Auto attacks and abilities apply stacks for enhanced effects.
passive.details: Tahm Kench's attacks and abilities apply stacks. At 3 stacks, his Q stuns and R can devour enemies.

abilities.name: Tongue Lash
abilities.summary: Lash out and slow; stuns enemies with 3 stacks.
abilities.details: Tahm Kench lashes his tongue, damaging and slowing the first enemy hit. Enemies with 3 stacks are stunned.

abilities.name: Abyssal Dive
abilities.summary: Dive underground and emerge at a location, knocking up enemies.
abilities.details: Tahm Kench dives underground, becoming unstoppable. He emerges at a target location, dealing damage and knocking up enemies.

abilities.name: Thick Skin
abilities.summary: Store damage taken; activate to heal or wait to gain a shield.
abilities.details: Passive: Tahm Kench stores damage taken as grey health. Active: Convert grey health to a shield. If he doesn't activate, the grey health heals him over time.

abilities.name: Devour
abilities.summary: Eat an ally to protect them, or an enemy with 3 stacks to damage them.
abilities.details: Tahm Kench devours a target. Allied champions are kept safe and can be spit out. Enemy champions with 3 stacks can be devoured, taking damage and being held briefly.
